sharepoint-safe.profile_description: ASCII only, no characters SharePoint or OneDrive reject or mangle and a shorter path budget. SharePoint URL-encodes the path, so a name that is legal on disk can still blow the server limit once encoded; this profile keeps well inside it. Use for any sync-based destination, including Teams document libraries.
sharepoint-safe.dataset_note: Real PDFs that issuers publish: ASIC's annotated example SOAs and ROAs, blank fact-find and risk-profile templates, super fund PDSs, plus synthetic mocks for documents no one publishes. Blank templates name no client and carry no date. The tool holds them all for review rather than guess where they belong. No client documents.
